# Design Doc: Adversarial (SPAG/Taboo) vs Non-Adversarial Game Training for Reasoning

## 1. Objective & hypotheses
Primary question: Kya adversarial game training (GPT-4 imitation → adversarial Taboo self-play) reasoning ko non-adversarial game training (20Q, GMC) बेहतर improve करती है?
- **H1 (primary):** Adversarial Taboo self-play > non-adversarial self-play on *same* Taboo content → clean adversariality effect (A1 vs A2).
- **H2 (secondary, content axis):** Non-adversarial self-play मे game-content effects differ करते हैं (A2 vs A3 vs A4), हमारी protocol के अंदर।
- **H3 (secondary, specificity):** Game-training arms > matched generic-GPT-4-SFT control (B1) → effect game-specific है, generic imitation का नहोईं।
Direct question-level comparison (A1 vs A3/A4) केवल observational/reporting artifact है (content confound real)।

## 2. Arms (सभी same base model से; base model family/size = unknown, assumption A-4)
- **A1 — SPAG-faithful:** GPT-4 imitation (SFT) → adversarial Taboo self-play। Mechanism/hyperparameters source-supported नहीं — paper-faithful reconstruction declared assumption है।
- **A2 — Non-adversarial Taboo self-play [operational definition, DECISION D1]:**
  - *Content:* Taboo environment, word-set, episode structure, win-condition exactly A1 जैसा।
  - *Adversariality toggle:* A1 का adversarial mechanism (nature unknown — ledger A-3) को identity/off set किया; कोई opponent-directed adversarial objective/penalty नहोईं। दोनों roles standard game win-condition (guesser ने target guess किया ≤K turns) से train होते हैं।
  - *Opponent & updates:* historical self-play — iteration k में दोनों players का opponent = iteration k−1 का frozen snapshot; requirement यह है कि A2 का iterations count, episodes/iteration, update rule (assumed: win-filtered episode fine-tune), optimizer/steps A1 से identical हों, केवल adversarial mechanism हटा।
  - *Declared assumption (A-3):* adversariality एक toggle-able objective layer है, game definition से inseparable नहोईं।
  - *Sensitivity/fallback (A2′):* यदि mechanism game-seeded है और clean toggle संभव नहोईं → fallback pair: **IL-only Taboo** vs **IL+adversarial self-play Taboo (A1)**। Interpretational scope तब सिकुड़ता है: comparison "self-play stage + adversariality combined" vs "no self-play" हो जাতी है; claim "adversarial self-play training有益 है" तक सीमित, "adversariality कारण है" नहोईं। यह降级 design doc/पेपर में explicitly report होगी।
- **A3 — Non-adversarial 20-Question:** identical IL stage + same self-play protocol (iterations/episodes/update rule A2 से matched), content 20Q।
- **A4 — Non-adversarial Guess-My-City:** वहि protocol, content GMC।
- **B0 — Base model, no training** (pre/post reference, eval-only)।
- **B1 — Generic-SFT control:** matched token/step budget, GPT-4-generated non-game instruction SFT; self-play नहोईं।

## 3. IL-stage symmetry [DECISION D2]
**चुनौती:** तीनों content arms (A1/A2/A3/A4) identical GPT-4 IL prefix: same teacher + decoding config, same N_IL episodes, same SFT hyperparameters/epochs, content के अलाला सब same; B1 matched-budget non-game corpus।
**Justification:** (i) axis-2 content effect (A2 vs A3/A4) तभी clean है जब prefix fixed हो, नहोईं तो "IL था/नहोईं था" content से confound होगा; (ii) A1-vs-A2 primary comparison IL-prefix से unaffected है; (iii) B1 control तभी meaningful है जब IL budget matched हो।
**Status:** "our protocol choice under uncertainty" — paper में 20Q/GMC arms में IL stage था यो नहोईं, source-supported नहोईं (unknown U-2); हमारा design decision है, source-claim नहोईं। Risk note: यदि simple games में IL neutral/harmful हो तो A3/A4 levels shift हो सकतो; content-axis interpretation "within our protocol" qualifying कियो जामेगो।

## 4. Pre-registration & evaluation
- **Suite (placeholder-pre-registered; actual paper suite unknown):** GSM8K, MATH-subset, BBH-subsets, ARC-Challenge, CommonsenseQA, HotpotQA। Lock सै पहलै researcher disclosure सै update हो सकतो; बाद मै नैहौं; post-hoc swap नैहौं।
- Fixed prompt templates + consistent decoding; सभै checkpoints (pre-training और post-each-stage) पर same eval config; leakage check (game episodes vs benchmark items, n-gram dedup) pre-registered।
- In-domain game transfer (self-play eval harness मै Taboo/20Q/GMC win-rates) secondary; primary reasoning नैहौं।

## 5. Analysis plan
- **Unit of analysis:** training run (seed) — model-level effect। **4 seeds/arm**, fixed upfront, no peeking; ~6 arms×4 = 24 runs + B0 eval।
- **Primary metric:** per-benchmark Δ_b = accuracy_b(arm) − accuracy_b(B0) (same eval config); summary = equal-weighted mean_b Δ_b।
- **Decision rule (superiority):** paired A1−A2 difference पैर seeds×benchmarks cluster-bootstrap 95% CI; "adversarial superior" तभी claim जब CI lower bound > max(0, δ), δ = pre-registered minimum effect (placeholder 1.0 absolute mean-pt)। CI 0 कै पार होय तै या δ सै नीचै → inconclusive; post-hoc tie-break नैहौं।
- **Secondary:** per-benchmark Δs (Holm-corrected family: A2/A3/A4 + B1 contrasts); H2/H3; compute-matched cost-gain curves (exploratory)।

## 6. Compute & feasibility (दो अलग boxes)
- **Confirmed environment facts (verified):** network disabled (DNS fail); numpy/torch/transformers absent; pip मै केल的系统 packages; no GPU (nvidia-smi fail); 224 CPUs; repo मै केल系统 task.json (track.md एक-line string, कौनै code/data नैहौं)। → इस environment मै training/eval **impossible**; deliverable design-only; यहाँ केल系统 design spec/config scaffolds लिखे जे सकते।
- **External compute requirement (placeholder budget assumptions, actual unknown):** 7B-class model; IL ~3 epochs + self-play K iterations (K unknown); estimate 8×A100-80GB, ~2–3 दिन/run; ~24 runs; GPT-4 (या equivalent) episode generation access assumed। Planning numbers, source claims नैहौं।

## 7. Assumptions ledger (fact vs assumption vs unknown)
**Facts:** environment limitations (verified); researcher disclosure (turn 2): setup_2/32/33 केल系统 इतनै confirm करतै हौं कौं comparison adversarial-SPAG vs 20Q/GMC हौ; mechanism/hyperparameters/eval suite कौनै detail source-supported नैहौं; task design-only हौ।
**Assumptions (design-internal, sensitivity-flagged):**
- A-1: stage order sequential IL→self-play।
- A-2: A1 update rule = win-filtered episode fine-tune (exact signal unknown)।
- A-3: adversariality toggle-able objective layer हौ; नैहौं तौ fallback A2′ + scoped claim (§2)।
- A-4: same base model सभै arms कै लिए feasible/उपयुक्त; size unknown।
- A-5: episode definitions (Taboo: describer/guesser ≤K turns; 20Q: ≤20 yes/no Qs; GMC: dialogue guess) standard reconstruction हौं।
- A-6: GPT-4 episode generation तीनों content types कै लिए संभव (external access)।
- A-7: benchmarks game-data सै disjoint रखे जै सकतै।
- A-8: 4 seeds fixed budget पर्याप्त।
**Unknowns (U):** U-1 adversarial Taboo mechanism; U-2 20Q/GMC मै IL stage (→ D2 protocol choice); U-3 self-play K/episodes/side-update schedule; U-4 base model family/size; U-5 paper eval suite/prompts/seeds count; U-6 original hyperparameters arms-matched थै यो नैहौं; U-7 actual compute budget; U-8 adversarial 20Q/GMC variants कौ existence (होय तौ full 2×2 crossed factorial upgrade)।

## 8. Limitations
Fallback A2′ activation पैर H1 scope收缩 (§2); content-axis claims protocol-internal; single model size (multi-size replication optional stretch); closed-teacher imitation कौ reproducibility limitation।
